callees.name: _build_module_description_prompt
callees.pre_condition: modified_modules is a non-empty list of module identifiers; phases_path points to a valid phases.json file
callees.post_condition: Returns a string prompt instructing the LLM agent to rewrite the description field for each module in modified_modules based on that module's current source_files entries in phases.json. Returns None if no module in the list still owns any source files.

callees.name: build_llm_cli_command
callees.pre_condition: model is a string identifying an LLM model; prompt is a string; cwd is an existing directory
callees.post_condition: Returns a CLI command sequence that, when executed in the given working directory, invokes the specified LLM model with the given prompt.

callees.name: run_opencode_traced
callees.signature: run_opencode_traced(proj_dir, work_dir, command, stage, input_files, output_files, summary, metadata) -> None
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory; work_dir is a writable directory; command is a valid CLI command sequence; stage is a string stage name; input_files and output_files are lists of file paths relative to the workspace
callees.post_condition: Executes the command via OpenCode subprocess. On success, every path in output_files exists at its expected location under work_dir with content reflecting the agent's output. On non-zero exit, raises subprocess.CalledProcessError.
